title: SONARITHM spec
description:
A SONARITHM sonification spec: data plus how it becomes sound (RFC-0001, RFC-0004).

Optional keys stay unset when the author omits them, so the spec records what was
written; defaults are applied separately and reported as Info diagnostics. Unknown
top-level keys are kept in `extensions`, and validation accepts only `x-` keys there.

experimental.description: Opt-in sound experiments, each off unless turned on (v0.4, RFC-0006).

lint.description: Lint rule levels and suppressions (v0.2, RFC-0004 §4).

name.description: A title, spoken by the legend.

seed.description: The seed every random stream derives from; default 0 (SDR-02). At most 2^53 − 1.

specVersion.description: The spec language version, `"0.4"` (or `"0.1"` to `"0.3"`, read as they are).

template.description: A template that designs the tracks and other sections (v0.2, RFC-0004 §2).

tracks.description: The tracks; at least one, unless `template` gives them.

$comment: Generated by `cargo xtask codegen` from the sonarithm-spec types; do not edit.

Audify.description: Audification speed (SDR-31): a speed-up factor or a target band.

oneOf.description: Numbers at equal distances per equal step.
Positive numbers at equal distances per equal ratio.

plotArea.description: The plot area in source coordinates; found by the extractor when absent.

system.description: The coordinate system; only `cartesian` in v0.2.

CalibrationAnchor.description: A source point and its value.

at.description:
The point in the source's own coordinates: pixels (y down, a pixel's centre at
+0.5), SVG user units, or PDF default user space.

value.description: A number (`linear`, `log`), an ISO 8601 date (`date`) or a label (`category`).

CalibrationAxes.description: The two axes of a calibration.

CalibrationAxis.description: One axis: its kind and at least two anchors.

anchors.description: Points on the source and the values they stand for; at least two.

Channel.description: One channel: either `field` (with mapping options) or a constant `value`.

field.description: The data field mapped to this channel.

range.description: The output range, low to high.

scale.description: How data values map onto the range.

ChannelRange.description: A channel range: a plain `[lo, hi]` or a unit-tagged range.

anyOf.description: A plain range for unitless channels.

ChannelValue.description: A constant channel value: a plain number, a preset name, or a unit-tagged value.

anyOf.description: A plain number (pan, brightness, taps, density, rate in events/s).

Channels.description: The channels of a track. Which channels a mark accepts is checked by validation.

loudness.description: Loudness in relative dB; constant by default (SDR-23).

pan.description: Stereo position, −1 to 1; never the sole carrier (A11Y-14).

timbre.description: Timbre preset, or a nominal field (SDR-25).

Context.description: `context` (AUDAXIS): ticks, reference tone, legend, earcons, spatial mode.

oneOf.description: x and y axes at right angles.

path.description: The correction file, relative to the spec.

Corrections.description: `data.source.corrections` (RFC-0004 §6): inline edits; the file form is reserved.

edits.description: The edits, applied in order after extraction and before `transform`.

CorrectionsSource.description:
`data.source.corrections` as written: inline edits, or (spec 0.3) a correction file
relative to the spec (RFC-0005 §7). For the schema; the compiler reads the JSON.

cents.description: The degrees in cents above the tonic.

tonic.description: The tonic, `A`–`G` with an optional `#` or `b`.

DataSpec.description: `data`: where the data comes from and what its fields mean.

missing.description: What missing values sound like; default `silence`.

levels.description: Description levels; default L1 and L2. L4 is rejected by validation.

oneOf.description: Interpretation; never automatic (A11Y-02), rejected by validation.

Domain.description: A scale domain: a keyword or `[min, max]`.

oneOf.description: From zero to the data extent.

to.description: The new point, in data units.

oneOf.description: A point at the wrong value.

point.description: The 0-based index in the extractor's order.

oneOf.description: A point that is not data.

point.description: The 0-based index in the extractor's order.

oneOf.description: A point given to the wrong series.

point.description: The 0-based index in the extractor's order.

lowConfidenceTimbre.description: Estimated values play in a darker timbre (SDR-43, `INFER`; H-06). Default `false`.

concept.description: The concept, such as `temperature`, which sets default polarity (SDR-12..14).

unit.description: Unit as free text, such as `°C`.

oneOf.description: Numbers on an interval or ratio scale.
A sound font (SF2) file the user supplies.

path.description: The SF2 file, relative to the spec.

JsonValue.description: Any JSON value. Numbers are `f64`, which is how RFC 8785 treats them for hashing.

anyOf.description: An object, with keys in sorted order.

parts.description: What it says; default: all parts.

LegendSpeak.description: When the legend is spoken (RFC-0001 Q14).

oneOf.description: Never spoken automatically; still in the navigation tree.

experimental.description: Turns on the experimental (`INFER`) rules; default `false`.

suppress.description: Rules turned off, for the spec or one track, each with a reason.

Mark.description: Mark kinds (04 §5.3) with their technique labels (SDR-06).

oneOf.description: A recorded sound per event (Auditory icon).
An excitable data model (MBS), Stage D.
Tone, glide or audification chosen from density (SDR-20, experimental).

Pace.description: The pace: exactly one of three keys.

oneOf.description: Data points per second (SDR-19: 2–4 for overviews).
The duration of the whole series.
Seconds per unit of the time field.

max.description: The corner with the larger coordinates.

min.description: The corner with the smaller coordinates.

PointValue.description: A point value in data units; either part may be absent where an edit allows it.

x.description: The x value (a number, or a label or date as text).

scale.description: The scale: a name such as `C major pentatonic`, or custom cents (RFC-0004 §7).

tuning.description: The tuning: `12-TET` (default for named scales), `just`, or custom cents.

timbre.description: Its timbre, distinct from the data.

track.description: The track it refers to; default: the first data track.

Scale.description: A scale from data values to the channel range.

domain.description: The data domain; default `"auto"` (the data extent).

nice.description: Round the domain to nice values; default `false`.

ScaleReference.description: The reference point `f_ref` at data value `d_ref` of a psychophysical scale (SDR-11).

ScaleSpec.description:
`music.quantize.scale`: a name such as `"D minor pentatonic"`, or custom degrees
(RFC-0004 §7).

anyOf.description: Degrees in cents above the tonic, strictly increasing from 0, below 1200.

SeriesTarget.description: The series a `retype` edit moves a point to.

format.description: File format; inferred from the extension when absent.

calibration.description: Axis calibration (typed in v0.2, RFC-0004 §5; read with [`crate::v02::read`]).

corrections.description: Corrections a person made to the extracted chart (v0.2, RFC-0004 §6).

oneOf.description: A sampled function (CURVASONA). Produces fields `x`, `y` and `dy`.

expr.description:
The expression in `x`, in the language of ADR-0028: ordinary precedence (`^` binds
tightest and is right-associative, so `-x^2` is `-(x^2)`), every product written
with `*`, the constants `pi`, `e` and `tau`, the names in `variables`, and the
functions sin, cos, tan, sec, csc, cot, asin, acos, atan, sinh, cosh, tanh, asinh,
acosh, atanh, exp, ln, log2, log10, sqrt, cbrt, abs, floor, ceil, round, trunc,
min, max and atan2. At most 1024 characters.

samples.description: Number of samples (at least 2); default 1000. Exclusive with `step`.

oneOf.description: A dataset loaded in a project.

Substrate.description: `substrate`: the temporal canvas (Enge et al., SDR-04).

track.description: The track it applies to; the whole spec when absent.

TemplateRef.description: `template`: a reusable design bound to a dataset's fields (RFC-0004 §2, SDR-03).

bind.description: Slot name → field name; slots not named bind by role, then by kind.

id.description: The template ID, lowercase `kebab-case`, as an engine registers it.

Threshold.description: A threshold whose crossing plays an earcon.

enabled.description: `"auto"` (on for discrete marks, off for glides), `true` or `false`.

every.description: Major tick interval in units of the time field.

field.description: The ordering field; default: the field with `role=x`, else row order.

anyOf.description: Decided by the compiler from the data and marks.

TrackSpec.description: One track: a stream of auditory marks.

engine.description: The encoder engine; default: the first encoder registered for the mark.

filter.description: A row filter for this track.

id.description: The track ID, unique in the spec (`^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$`).

instrument.description: The instrument preset; default: the encoder's (SDR-29).

mark.description: The mark. Required: `auto` depends on SDR-20, an experimental rule (RFC-0001 Q16).

redundant.description: Redundant encodings of the pitch field (A11Y-13).

method.description: How values in an interval combine.

oneOf.description: A new field from an expression.

anyOf.description: The twelve pitch classes in cents above the tonic.

UnitRange.description: A two-element range with a unit key, such as `{ "hz": [400, 1400] }`.

UnitValue.description: A value with a unit key.
